walkthroughs.title: Forge your first 3D model
walkthroughs.outcome: A textured, downloadable GLB from one sentence of text.
walkthroughs.blurb: The free text-to-3D lane, end to end: what to type, which engine to pick, and where the finished model lands.

steps.title: One box is the whole product
steps.body: Forge opens on a single composer. Describe an object, upload photos of a real one, or scribble a sketch. Every lane below leads to the same place: a textured GLB you own.
steps.tip: No account and no wallet are needed to generate. Sign in only when you want the model saved to your library.

fill: a brass compass, weathered, cracked glass

steps.title: Name one object and one material
steps.body: The prompt coach under the box is live: it reads what you typed and tells you what is missing. One object plus one material beats a paragraph of adjectives every time.
steps.tip: Stuck? Surprise me writes a known-good prompt, and Enhance rewrites yours without changing the subject.

steps.title: Pick an engine, or just take the free one
steps.body: Engines are labelled with what they cost you. The ones tagged FREE need no API key and no card. Busy and unavailable states are live, so you are never sent at a lane that cannot answer.
steps.tip: Quality steps from Draft to High. High is a $THREE holder perk, and the note under the picker links straight to it.

steps.title: Generate, then watch it build
steps.body: One button. The stage on the right renders a preview image first, then builds the mesh, so you can bail out early if the silhouette is wrong instead of waiting on a full generation.

action.label: Try it on the real page

steps.title: Everything lands in the gallery
steps.body: Finished models drop into Fresh from the Forge alongside everyone else's. Each card opens the model in 3D, and anything public can be remixed as the starting point for your next one.

walkthroughs.title: Build your first agent
walkthroughs.outcome: A named agent with a body, a personality, and a shareable URL.
walkthroughs.blurb: Five steps, and the first one fills in the other four for you. Build the whole thing before you ever sign in.

steps.title: Five steps, always visible
steps.body: Basics, model, skills, personality, review. The stepper is a map, not a cage: every step you have already reached stays clickable, so you can jump back without losing what you typed.
steps.tip: Progress is kept locally as you go. Closing the tab does not cost you the agent.

fill: A calm meditation coach who runs short breathing sessions and speaks in a warm, unhurried voice

steps.title: Describe it once in plain English
steps.body: One sentence into this box and Generate fills the name, the description, the skill selection, and the personality sliders across all five steps. The wizard becomes a review pass instead of a form.
steps.tip: Everything it writes stays editable. It is a first draft, not a decision.

steps.title: Or start from a known-good shape
steps.body: The chips are complete starting points, not placeholder text: meditation coach, market analyst, 3D art critic, onboarding host. Surprise me picks one you would not have thought of.
steps.tip: Pick a chip, then edit one thing. That is usually a better agent than a blank start.

steps.title: The form is short on purpose
steps.body: Each step asks for the minimum it genuinely needs and offers a sensible default for the rest. You can walk from the first step to the review screen without typing anything else.

steps.title: Sign in only when you ship
steps.body: Building costs nothing and needs no account. Signing in is what turns the draft into a hosted agent with its own page, its own URL, and a wallet it can be paid through.

walkthroughs.title: Embed a 3D avatar on your site
walkthroughs.outcome: One script tag that puts a live, animated avatar on any page you control.
walkthroughs.blurb: Configure it by clicking, watch the code rewrite itself, then copy the tag. No build step, no framework.

steps.title: The playground is the documentation
steps.body: Editor on the left, live avatar on the right. It is not a video or a screenshot of an IDE: the preview is the real web component running the exact code in the box.
steps.tip: HTML, React, and Vue tabs emit the same component with the syntax each ecosystem expects.
steps.pageTitle: three.ws - The 3D Agent Layer of the Internet

steps.title: Pick a body by clicking one
steps.body: Each swatch swaps the avatar in the preview and rewrites the src attribute in the code. These are the same hosted GLBs your production embed will load.
steps.tip: Any model you forge or upload can go here too. Swap the src for your own URL.
steps.pageTitle: three.ws - The 3D Agent Layer of the Internet

steps.title: Toggle the behaviour, not the CSS
steps.body: Responsive sizing, a nameplate, the chat dock, eager loading. Each chip is one attribute on the tag, so what you turn on here is exactly what ships.
steps.tip: Background chips cover the common cases: transparent over your hero, or a dark or light plate.
steps.pageTitle: three.ws - The 3D Agent Layer of the Internet

steps.title: The code is editable, both ways
steps.body: Clicking a chip writes into the editor, and typing in the editor updates the preview. Break it on purpose to see how it fails before you paste it into your own page.
steps.pageTitle: three.ws - The 3D Agent Layer of the Internet

steps.title: Copy the tag and you are done
steps.body: One script tag and one element. It works in a static HTML file, a WordPress theme, a Shopify template, or a React app, because it is a web component and not a framework plugin.

walkthroughs.title: Find an agent worth using
walkthroughs.outcome: A shortlist of working agents, filtered by what they do and what they cost.
walkthroughs.blurb: The marketplace is thousands of entries deep. Here is the path from the front door to something you would actually run.

steps.title: Start with the weekly theme
steps.body: The strip at the top is a curated cut of the catalogue that rotates. When you do not yet know what you are looking for, it is a far better entry point than an empty search box.
steps.tip: Browse opens the full theme as a filtered view rather than a static list.

steps.title: Featured entries load in real 3D
steps.body: The hero is a live viewer, not a render. Spin the avatar, open it in the 3D lobby, or fork it straight into a new agent of your own from the same card.
steps.tip: Start an agent carries the body over, so you skip the model step in the builder.

steps.title: Filter by kind, then by price
steps.body: Agents, avatars, and onchain entries are different things and the chips keep them apart. The price filter is honest about which listings are free and which charge per call.
steps.tip: Counts on the chips are live, so an empty result is visible before you click it.

steps.title: Categories carry real counts
steps.body: Academic, career, design, education, and the rest, each with the number of live entries behind it. The number is what tells you whether a category is worth opening.
steps.tip: Category and price filters compose. Free plus Design is one click away from here.

steps.title: Check the pulse before you commit
steps.body: Agents live, prompts scored today, win rate, open trades. This strip is the fastest read on whether the thing you are about to depend on is actually being used right now.
